data_leakage.details: Point-in-time ELO, rolling team statistics, and H2H data now strictly enforce t < match_timestamp. Zero future data leakage.

synthetic_odds.details: Synthetic inverted probability odds backtesting formula removed. Integrated 8,822 real Pinnacle opening (PSH, PSD, PSA) and closing (PSCH, PSCD, PSCA) odds.

model_calibration.details: In-sample calibration training replaced with Out-of-Fold (OOF) cross-validation TimeSeriesSplit pipeline. Multi-method calibration (Isotonic, Platt, Beta, Temperature Scaling) supported.

gbm_model_lifecycle.details: Removed silent 7-day import-time model shutdown in model/ensemble.py. Added automated model health validation and candidate gatekeeper.

clv_and_settlement.details: CLV tracking pipeline connected to bet execution with full 1X2, Over/Under 2.5, and BTTS support. Result tracker updated to evaluate actual goals scored.

league_coverage.details: Re-enabled Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, and Champions League in config/settings.py. Multi-season cache now automatically loaded.
